text:
Situation: Imipenem and cilastatin 500 mg + 500 mg injection is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 66 vials with 4 days of supply at 16.5 vials per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 105 vials with 29.8 days of supply at 3.5 vials per day. Corvale General holds 472 vials with 29.5 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists the product as "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided. The drug shortage list does not include this product as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal redistribution can cover the East campus gap without external purchase. Lakeside and General both have sufficient inventory to support transfers while maintaining at least two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 55 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. This leaves Lakeside with 14 days and brings East to 7 days. Approval required: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 166 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East. This leaves General with 14 days and brings East to 14 days. Approval required: pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. If transfers are not feasible, purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC. The supplier is not on the FDA shortage list today. Approval required: buyer.

Not recommended: No action, as East would exhaust supply in 4 days.
